about.description:
ERFA (Essential Routines for Fundamental Astronomy) is a C library containing key algorithms for
astronomy, and is based on the [SOFA library](http://www.iausofa.org/) published by the International
Astronomical Union (IAU).

ERFA is intended to replicate the functionality of SOFA (aside from possible
bugfixes in ERFA that have not yet been included in SOFA), but is licensed
under a three-clause BSD license to enable its compatibility with a wide
range of open source licenses.

name: liberfa

about.description:
ERFA (Essential Routines for Fundamental Astronomy) is a C library containing key algorithms for
astronomy, and is based on the [SOFA library](http://www.iausofa.org/) published by the International
Astronomical Union (IAU).

ERFA is intended to replicate the functionality of SOFA (aside from possible
bugfixes in ERFA that have not yet been included in SOFA), but is licensed
under a three-clause BSD license to enable its compatibility with a wide
range of open source licenses.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.0.1"

package:
  name: liberfa
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/liberfa/erfa/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d5469fbd0b212b3c7270c1da15c9bd82f37da9218fc89627f98283d27b416cbf

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    # Not supported upstream
    - win
  script: |
    meson setup build ${MESON_ARGS}
    meson compile -C build -j ${CPU_COUNT}
    if [[ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-}" != "1" || "${CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR}" != "" ]]; then
      meson test -C build --print-errorlogs
    fi
    meson install -C build

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - meson
    - ninja
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("liberfa", upper_bound="x") }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      include:
        - erfa.h
        - erfam.h
        - erfaextra.h
        - erfadatextra.h
      lib:
        - erfa
      files:
        - lib/pkgconfig/erfa.pc

  - script:
      - pkg-config --modversion erfa
    requirements:
      run:
        - pkg-config

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/liberfa/erfa
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Essential Routines for Fundamental Astronomy
  description: |
    ERFA (Essential Routines for Fundamental Astronomy) is a C library containing key algorithms for
    astronomy, and is based on the [SOFA library](http://www.iausofa.org/) published by the International
    Astronomical Union (IAU).
    
    ERFA is intended to replicate the functionality of SOFA (aside from possible
    bugfixes in ERFA that have not yet been included in SOFA), but is licensed
    under a three-clause BSD license to enable its compatibility with a wide
    range of open source licenses.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - eunos-1128
